editorial: While developers today are focusing on tools that provide AI models with long-term memory and skill management, a critical TCP vulnerability (use-after-free) is coming to the fore on the security side. On the Hugging Face platform, self-distillation methods that increase the reasoning capacity of large language models and new benchmarks focused on financial forecasting are attracting attention.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: thedotmack/claude-mem is a tool that provides persistent context across sessions for AI agents. It compresses session data using AI and transfers relevant information to subsequent interactions, working compatibly with various coding assistants like Claude Code.

snapshot.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: Mattpocock/skills contains AI agent skills used in software development processes and designed directly for real engineering work. The developer shares these tools to increase efficiency in daily workflows and to automate practical engineering tasks.

snapshot.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory. My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.

items.title: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
items.summary: Claude-Code-Game-Studios transforms the Claude Code software development tool into a comprehensive game studio with 49 AI agents and 72 workflow capabilities. It aims to automate game development processes with a coordination system that reflects a real studio hierarchy.

snapshot.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.summary: T3 Code is an agent harness control surface that allows you to manage AI agents on your local machine. It enables you to establish centralized control over your agents via mobile apps, a web interface, and an Electron-based desktop application.

snapshot.description: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app.

items.title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
items.summary: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu stands out as an open-source astrological chart engine based on Ni Haixia's Tianji system. The project offers a comprehensive 13-dimensional interpretation dataset and a complete calculation algorithm covering dates between 1950 and 2026.

snapshot.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据. 1. 发布 13 维解读数据集 v4.0 —— 674,976 张命盘（公历 1950–2026 年每一个真实日期 × 12 时辰 × 男女）× 13 维 = 8,774,688 段解读，正文约 204 亿字。解压后 56.6 GB（v3.0 为 33.1 GB，增加 71%），压缩后只有 161 MB，按年份分 77 个文件，可以只下需要的年份，也可以一次下全年份总包。下载见 Release v4.0-13d，规格和字段见第二·新章。发布前 77 个文件逐个解压，与原始数据逐字节比对一致。

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.summary: OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative that allows you to create your own AI bot team within chat applications. The project is developed in TypeScript with support for a virtual machine that bots can utilize.

snapshot.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use. The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: Developed in Rust, impeccable offers a design dictionary for AI agents that write code. This tool aims to prevent the deployment of low-quality content generated by AI (AI slop) by performing error checking during software development processes.

snapshot.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a capability framework and software development methodology developed for AI agents that code. It aims to standardize software development processes for agents through composable skills and guidance instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: lightpanda-io/browser
items.summary: Lightpanda is a headless browser written in the Zig language, specifically developed for AI and automation processes. It aims to optimize data scraping operations by processing web pages quickly over the network.

snapshot.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation. Requesting 933 real web pages over the network on a AWS EC2 m5.large instance. See benchmark details.

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.summary: DeepTutor is an agent-native workspace that combines learning, research, content creation, and application processes into a single extensible system. Offering personalized lifelong learning support, this platform aims to integrate educational processes in a digital environment.

snapshot.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, research, creation, and practice in one extensible system.

items.title: Orkas-AI/Orkas
items.summary: Orkas is an open-source AI team that runs on desktop computers and converts goals into task lists. Coordinating sixteen built-in expert agents and various coding models, this application offers a local-first workspace on macOS and Windows.

snapshot.description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.

items.title: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC
items.summary: OpenMAIC is an open-source artificial intelligence platform that transforms any topic or document into an interactive classroom environment. It brings students together with AI teachers that prepare presentations, quizzes, and simulations using multi-agent orchestration technology.

snapshot.description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click. OpenMAIC (Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom) is an open-source AI platform that turns any topic or document into a rich, interactive classroom experience. Powered by multi-agent orchestration, it generates slides, quizzes, interactive simulations, and project-based learning activities — all delivered by AI teachers and AI classmates who can speak, draw on a whiteboard, and engage in…

items.title: bregman-arie/devops-exercises
items.summary: devops-exercises is a resource repository containing DevOps interview questions covering a wide range of topics from Linux to cloud platforms and container technologies. It aims to support candidates in their preparation process with technical questions regarding industry-standard tools (such as Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform).

snapshot.description: Linux, Jenkins, AWS, SRE, Prometheus, Docker, Python, Ansible, Git, Kubernetes, Terraform, OpenStack, SQL, NoSQL, Azure, GCP, DNS, Elastic, Network, Virtualization. DevOps Interview Questions

items.title: vorssaint/vorssaint-utils
items.summary: Vorssaint-utils is an open-source menu bar toolkit developed for the macOS operating system. It combines many different functions such as application-based audio control, system monitoring, window management, and clipboard history into a single interface.

snapshot.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit. Per app volume, a real system monitor, a better app switcher, window snapping, Dock previews, clipboard history, text snippets, a file shelf, an uninstaller. The utilities Mac users usually buy one by one, together behind a single menu bar icon, with no account, no telemetry and no subscription.

items.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
items.summary: HackerTube presents thousands of videos shared in Hacker News comments since 2007 through a YouTube-like interface. The platform aggregates 6,454 videos that stand out in technology-focused discussions in a single hub.

snapshot.description: YouTube-style UI over 6,454 videos sourced from 39,834 HN comments since 2007.https://hackertube.org/

items.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
items.summary: The security vulnerability coded CVE-2026-98432, detected in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP protocol stack, is rated as critical with a 9.8 CVSS score due to a use-after-free error. This vulnerability creates a flaw that could lead to unauthorized access or service disruption on the system.

items.title: An Italian farmer found some unknown seeds in his attic and planted them
items.summary: Claudio Grossi, an Italian farmer, obtained an ancient grain variety from seeds he found and planted in his attic. This plant, which draws attention with its seven-eared stalk, is considered a discovery that could offer solutions to modern agricultural problems.

snapshot.description: When a seven-eared stem emerged from the ground, it seemed like a miracle. What Claudio Grossi had unearthed was an ancient grain that proved to be an answer to some modern problems

items.title: Anthropic blocks users for anything touching training larger models
items.summary: Anthropic is blocking the accounts of users engaged in activities aimed at training larger models. The company's usage policies include restrictions regarding the processes of training or developing artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
items.summary: Parameter.ai researchers have developed a method that bypasses ChatGPT's sandbox and content security policies to take over user accounts. This method provides account access via a special link sent to target users.

snapshot.description: By bypassing ChatGPT's sandbox and content security policy, our research team was able to take over anyone's account simply by sending them a link.

items.title: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B
items.summary: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B is presented as an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Developers aim to distill the capabilities of this model into smaller models by creating a high-capacity teacher agent.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. In Nanbeige4.3, we take a foundational step toward pushing the boundaries of lightweight agents. Our strategy centers on building a high-capacity teacher agent first, which will subsequently anchor the distillation of advanced agentic capabilities into smaller models.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text-based inputs. While providing performance improvements in reasoning, coding, and agent-based tasks compared to the previous version, it aims to increase cost efficiency by reducing processing time and output length.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
items.summary: LFM3-1.7B, developed by LiquidAI, is a text-generation model designed for local agents and custom applications. Built on a new tri-hybrid architecture, this model focuses on specialized tasks with a low parameter count.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

items.title: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
items.summary: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B, developed by NVIDIA, is an open-weight automatic speech recognition model capable of transcribing in 40 languages. Supporting recordings up to one hour long, the model offers a 65,536-token context window with a mixture-of-experts architecture.

snapshot.description: automatic-speech-recognition model. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages, with support for recordings up to one hour and a 65,536-token context. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates approximately 4.3B parameters, including the audio encoder, and it is released in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision.

items.title: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B
items.summary: The mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B released on Hugging Face is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text inputs. This Mixture-of-Experts architecture, which has one trillion parameters, was trained exclusively in Mistral's data centers in Europe.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Mistral Large 4 is our largest and most capable model to date: a 1 trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers), trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own datacenters in Europe.

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.summary: EPSBench is an evaluation tool developed to measure the quarterly earnings prediction capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Using data from 86 US-based companies, this system tests the ability of AI agents to analyze financial documents and generate evidence-based forecasts.

snapshot.description: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted ear

items.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
items.summary: The paper published on Hugging Face introduces a weakening-induced on-policy self-distillation method to improve reasoning models in the absence of an external teacher model. This approach, called WISD, creates a weaker copy of the original model and uses the difference between the two models as a training signal via unlabeled prompts.

snapshot.description: Self-distillation offers a way to improve reasoning models when a suitable external teacher is unavailable. However, common approaches rely on privileged information to construct a stronger self-teacher, limiting their use when only unlabeled prompts are available. In this paper, we introduce Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation (WISD), which instead constructs a weaker counterpart of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal without requiring privile

items.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
items.summary: The paper shared by Hugging Face examines methods for generating in any order without being bound to a fixed scanning order in pre-trained autoregressive visual models. The study aims to enable models to perform operations such as visual editing, inpainting, and outpainting without additional training costs.

snapshot.description: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compa

items.title: Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
items.summary: The study titled 'Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents' examines the impact of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and command-line interfaces (CLI) on model behavior when language models interact with external tools. The research analyzes whether different interface representations change the decision-making processes of AI agents, even when the same functional capabilities are provided.

snapshot.description: Language agents increasingly act through external tools and interactive environments, making the interface between the model and its executable capabilities part of the decision process. Model Context Protocol (MCP) and command-line interfaces (CLI) can expose the same semantic operations through markedly different model-facing representations. We study whether these representational differences change agent behavior when executable capabilities are matched. We introduce Matched Interface Compar

items.title: Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
items.summary: The paper titled 'Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them', published on Hugging Face, reveals that quantized large language models (LLMs) in public registries fail functionality tests. The research states that a portion of the examined models fail at coding tasks and presents methods for detecting such faulty AI models.

snapshot.description: Developers download quantized large language models (LLMs) from public registries to run them locally. None of the registries we examined documented functional testing of their files. We tested all 305 eligible code-capable GGUF tags (the llama.cpp format) across 15 model lines in the official Ollama library, plus 22 popular Hugging Face community files. A 15-task code screen identified suspects, which we retested on all 164 HumanEval+ tasks. Seven official tags (2.3%) solved at most six of them

glossary.explanation: It is a data storage method that allows AI agents to remember previous conversations and maintain the flow of information between different sessions.
It is a set of specialized capabilities that AI agents possess to perform specific engineering tasks.
It is a control panel that allows you to manage and direct AI agents running on your computer.
It is a software tool that performs personal chart calculations using traditional astrology rules.
It is a type of software whose source code is open for everyone to access and improve.
It is a term used to describe low-quality, sloppy, or worthless content generated by artificial intelligence.
It is a set of ready-made structural tools that accelerate software development processes and ensure working within a specific order.
It is a type of browser that does not have a visual interface and can load and process web pages in the background.
It defines systems designed specifically for the use and collaboration of artificial intelligence agents.
It is an approach that prioritizes storing and processing data directly on the user's own device without the need for the internet.
It is a management process that enables multiple artificial intelligence agents to work in harmony towards a common goal.
It is a security vulnerability that occurs when a program attempts to use a memory area after it has been freed.
It is a restricted area that allows software to be run in a safe and isolated environment without harming the main system.
It is the process of artificial intelligence generating meaningful sentences and texts in accordance with the commands given to it.
It is a method of transferring the knowledge of a large and complex artificial intelligence model to a smaller, faster, and lighter model.
It is a special model structure created by combining three different working principles or technologies.
